title: Traveling system in my RPG game
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey guys! Just wanted to share another update on GodScar, this time showcasing the Asterwake, the massive skyship you'll be using to travel throughout the world.

The Asterwake isn't just there for looks. It's going to serve as your main form of transportation and a home for you and your companions as the story progresses.

Rather than traveling across a traditional world map, you'll be flying between different regions and biomes. And the journey itself is part of the experience. You'll be able to explore the ship, interact with your crew, build relationships, and encounter different monsters and events along the way.

I'm also planning different weather systems that will affect the atmosphere of your travels. Flying through a violent storm should feel completely different from cruising above the clouds on a clear morning. The monsters you encounter will also depend on the regions you're traveling through.

As the story progresses, more of the world will open up, giving you access to new locations, biomes, and discoveries. There may even be a few secrets hidden aboard the Asterwake itself!

A little about the workflow for those interested...

Opus 5.5 handles most of the development in Godot, including coding, 3D work, and reviewing gameplay footage to identify issues. I also use Claude Sonnet 5.5 for research, testing and gathering references, while Codex helps create concept images and visual references for environments and models plus any model reviews i may need. Blender is used for the actual 3D modeling, including the Asterwake and its surrounding sky environment.

Everything shown is still early alpha footage, so there's definitely a lot more work to be done.

I'd love to hear what you guys think! What kind of features, random events, or weather conditions would you like to see while traveling aboard the Asterwake?

As always, any feedback, suggestions, or questions about the development process are greatly appreciated!
